sessionFindings: GetAvatarSessionsAsync returns demo devices, IPs, locations and counts.
CreateAvatarSessionAsync creates only an in-memory object with no storage save.
UpdateAvatarSessionAsync synthesizes fields rather than loading/persisting a real session.
Selected/all logout return success without revocation.
revocationTrace.existingRealPath: RefreshToken/RevokeTokenCore load exact authoritative refresh credential and save through SaveAvatarSession with provider binding. Preserve this owner rather than add a separate disconnected session store.
revocationTrace.requestValidation: JWT middleware validates signature/identity and loads avatar, but does not check a persistent session revocation state. Token generation lacks session identity/revocation-version binding.
revocationTrace.requiredInvariant: An acknowledged revocation must persist at the token authority, stop further refresh and invalidate all corresponding access tokens across WEB4-WEB10 validators; session list/stats must derive from the same persisted records.
implementationOrder: Define persisted session/token identity and authority binding shared by issuance, refresh and validation.
Implement acknowledged atomic session mutations and actual list/stats using shipping providers; preserve concurrent auth/profile updates.
Update all API validation consumers, including WEB5-WEB10, before claiming cross-service logout.
Only then connect Settings all-session action; verify owned native end-to-end revoked token refusal and unrelated-account preservation.
